description: Use the existing prime-power family as a boundary condition rather than pretending it solves the unsupported frontier. The family becomes a calibration tool for what algebraic structure is already captured.
mathematical_formalization: If q=2n-1 is a prime power with q \equiv 1 mod 4, emit the Paley-type two-block witness; otherwise do not extrapolate.
analogical_connections: validity region of a perturbation series
implementation_hypothesis: Keep theorem-backed family generation but surround it with explicit tests and unsupported-case refusal.
experiment_seed: Regress the prime-power values in the frozen support table and ensure non-prime-power composites remain unsupported.

closest_prior_art.title: Lower bounds for book Ramsey numbers
FSG: Fast String Graph Construction for De Novo Assembly

novelty_claim: The novelty is the discipline of using the family as a verified boundary, not as a rhetorical substitute for a general algorithm.
differentiation: This is a framing/control idea, not a claim of a new infinite construction.
